ItemID: NA; Title: VELCRO Brand Heavy Duty Tape | 12 Foot Roll | Strong Sticky Back Adhesive Holds up to 10 lbs | Industrial Strength Fasteners for Indoor or Outdoor Use | 1-1/2in Width, White (VEL-30837-USA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for removable workshop mounting; my previous adhesive hook-and-loop strips suggest I would find it useful.

ItemID: NA; Title: DAJIANG Over The Door Hook Hanger, Towel Rack with 6 Coat Hooks for Towels, Coat, Clothes, Bag, Robe, Back of Bathroom (1, Silver); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in workshop supplies right now and have no immediate need for a door hanger.

ItemID: NA; Title: Synthetic Filter Paper Sticker 65 mm 0.3 μm PTFE Filter Disc Strong Adhesive Patch for Regular Mouth Mason Jar Lid Mushroom Cultivation (18pcs); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Mushroom cultivation supplies do not connect to the repair and fabrication projects I am shopping for.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bethshaya self-Drilling Screws Assortment 210Pcs 410 Stainless Steel Phillips self Tapping Screws for Metal,5 Sizes (1/2 Inch, 3/4 Inch,1 Inch,1-1/4 Inch,1-1/2 Inch); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for sheet-metal fastening because the size assortment complements my drill bits, rivets, and existing hardware.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vashly Digital Turbine Flow Meter Digital LCD Display with NPT Counter for Measure Diesel Kerosene Gasoline (1 Inch); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current fuel-transfer measurement need that would justify this specialized meter.
ItemID: NA; Title: 240 Pieces M2.5 Male Female Hex Brass Standoffs Spacers Screws Nuts Kit, Kindroufly Brass Standoffs Assortment Kit for PCB Motherboard; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small assembly hardware interests me, but I would wait until I need M2.5 spacing for a particular electronics project.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for general repairs and temporary securing; it serves different purposes from my double-sided mounting tape.
